div.div: What should I wear with white sneakers?
The model plans the catalog searches from its own taste. The looks are never read.

div.span: Worn in those looks, by kind

div.div: Kept if a look wears them
a garment no look wears cannot start a walk
one per occasion first; their pieces go to the catalog search and the answer prompt
your graph gives its own numbers
